name: Wall & Desk
description: Little things for walls and desks: sticky notes, index cards and labels; wall and desk clocks (any time zone); a month calendar you can write on and a day calendar; an outdoor thermometer and a weather forecast. Everyone in a shared space sees the same ones. Weather from Open-Meteo.

variants.name: Sticky note
variants.description: A square note for reminders and to-dos. Mark it done when it's done.

variants.name: Index card
variants.description: A ruled card with room for a few lines: a recipe, a list, directions.

variants.name: Label
variants.description: A narrow strip to name things: shelves, boxes, switches, plants.

variants.name: Wall clock
variants.description: A round clock with a sweeping second hand. Set it to any time zone.

variants.name: Desk clock
variants.description: Big glowing digits and the date, for a desk or a shelf.

variants.name: Calendar
variants.description: This month on the wall, today circled. Tap a day to write on it; ◀ ▶ for other months.

variants.name: Day calendar
variants.description: A tear-off desk calendar: today's date, big.

variants.name: Thermometer
variants.description: How warm it is outside, on a classic tube thermometer.

variants.name: Weather
variants.description: Now and the next five days: sky, highs and lows, chance of rain.

settings.label: Home city
settings.help: Weather and the thermometer use it until you pick a place for one

gestures.name: Wall & Desk
gestures.how: Tap a note to write; tap a calendar day to write on it
gestures.more: Place a note, clock, calendar, thermometer or weather on a wall or table from Place → Wall & Desk. Tap a note or a calendar day to write. Hold the pin (notes) or the frame (everything else) to move it. Clocks: 🌍 in the menu changes the time zone. Weather and the thermometer: 📍 sets the place (or set a home city in the app's settings).
